thread:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a tail-latency/throughput mismatch on the non-chat vector-ranker endpoint this morning. p99 spiking after the cuBLAS driver bump?
aj: Can you paste the traces/metrics? which model + seq lengths?
maria: Mostly reranker v2 (384 dim embeddings), short queries (~10-30 tokens) but high QPS. p50 fine, p95 ~120ms, p99 ~480ms for a 2-GPU pod.
jiwon: Dumping a quick perf sample from the runtime profiler:
```
# timeline excerpt
time: 2026-03-15T09:12:01Z
- queue_wait_ms median: 12
- batch_formation_ms p95: 142
- kernel_launch_ms p95: 18
- gpu_util: 67% (jitter)
- kv_cache_evictions/sec: 31
- p99 latency: 482ms
```
perf-bot: ModelSelector: picked kernel "matmul_autotuned_v3" for seq<=64, fallback to "matmul_generic" at runtime 14% due to shape mismatch.
eva: That kv_cache_evictions/sec number stands out — sounds like KV thrashing when many small requests map to different keys. Could cause extra memory copies and kernel switching.
aj: Also check the batcher policy — if continuous batcher waits too long to meet token budget for small queries we end up with fewer but bigger batches => worse tail. We tuned token budget earlier to 2048 tokens; maybe that's too aggressive for reranker mix.
maria: I ran a quick experiment: forcing max_wait_ms=6ms reduced p99 to ~220ms but throughput dropped 8%. Good trade for customer-facing SLAs though.
sam: Proposed heuristic update: 1) separate per-model queue for rerank endpoints, 2) prefer pack-by-token for small-token requests, 3) add KV pinning for top-100 frequent keys, 4) fallback kernel hysteresis to avoid churn.
tony: Note: recent driver update changed workspace alignment which made matmul_autotuned_v3 less stable for tiny mats — that explains kernel churn. We should pin kernel selection until driver fix landed.
jiwon: Here's a suggested config snippet for the canary (5% traffic) — use CLI to apply:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/endpoints/canary -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{
  "model": "reranker-v2",
  "batcher": {
    "mode": "continuous",
    "max_wait_ms": 6,
    "token_budget_target": 1024,
    "pack_strategy": "token_first",
    "per_model_queue": true
  },
  "kv_cache": {
    "pin_top_n": 100,
    "eviction_policy": "lru_strict"
  },
  "kernel_selector": {
    "enable_hysteresis": true,
    "switch_threshold_ms": 50
  }
}'
```
maria: I'll spin the canary at 5% in staging now. Will monitor p50/p95/p99 & gpu occupancy.
aji: (typo) meant aj: Please add observability: per-model batch size histogram, kv_eviction_rate, kernel_switch_count.
perf-bot: Canary started for reranker-v2 @ 5% traffic. Will report hourly.
eva: If pin_top_n reduces kv evictions we should see lower host->device memcpy and less kernel variability. Also consider increasing small-matrix matmul microkernel path for seq<=32.
sam: Quick experiment suggestion: try token_budget_target=768 and token_first packing. If p99 still >300ms revert.
tony: If we pin kernel, add an automatic rollback if p99 increases >20% vs baseline for 10 minutes. Driver fix ETA from infra team is 48-72h.
maria: Thanks — plan: 1) canary at 5% (maria) 2) telemetry added (aj) 3) try token_budget_target 768 after 30m if p99 not improved (sam) 4) pin kernel with rollback (tony).
jiwon: Logging note: include kernel_selector decisions in trace span as `kernel.name` and `kernel.reason` so we can correlate with evictions.
maria: Also adding a short profiling capture for 1% of requests (stack + nvprof) to catch any kernel regressions.
sam: Will open an infra PR to add hysteresis + per-model queue in the batcher codepath.
maria: Awesome — will update thread with initial canary numbers in ~15m. :thumbsup:
